# Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0515a)

**ID:** Atk S0515a
**Section:** Aṭṭhakathā Khuddakanikāya (atk-s05)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā*, also known by the title *Saddhammapajjotikā*, is the commentary on the *Mahāniddesa* in the Khuddakanikāya section of the Pali commentarial corpus (*Aṭṭhakathā*) [Norman 1983]. It is known in modern scholarship through publications such as the Hewavitarne (Simon Hewavitarne Bequest) edition [Adikaram 1946], and is routinely cited in historical and doctrinal surveys of Pali Buddhism [Adikaram 1946; Karunadasa 1967].

**Sources**

- [Norman 1983] K. R. Norman, Pali Literature (A History of Indian Literature, Vol. VII, Fasc. 2, 1983) — Identifies the commentary by its alternative title Saddhammapajjotikā
- [Adikaram 1946] E. W. Adikaram, Early History of Buddhism in Ceylon (1946) — Cites the Hewavitarana edition introduction and includes the text in its bibliography
- [Karunadasa 1967] Y. Karunadasa, Buddhist Analysis of Matter (1967) — Lists the text in doctrinal study bibliography
